      "body": "### Pull Request Overview\n\nThe PR hardens numeric guardrails across money management and dutching calculations, but it is currently not up to standards according to Codacy. The most significant concern is a logic bypass in the PnL Engine where non-finite commission percentages can still enter calculations via the instance's default state, violating the primary acceptance criteria. Additionally, the dutching module contains a type-safety issue in its summation logic that could cause runtime errors when performing finiteness checks. One required test scenario for commission validation is currently missing.\n\n#### About this PR\n- The PnLEngine constructor allows storing non-finite commission_pct in the object state. Systemic numeric hardening should apply guardrails at the point of object initialization to prevent valid methods from operating on an invalid internal state.\n\n<details>\n<summary><b><code>1</code> comment outside of the diff</b></summary>\n\n<details>\n<summary><code>pnl_engine.py</code></summary>\n\n> <sub>`line 47` :white_circle: LOW RISK</sub>\n> Suggestion: To ensure the engine remains deterministic, consider applying _finite_float to the commission_pct in __init__ as well, preventing the object from being initialized with an invalid numeric state.\n\n</details>\n\n</details>\n\n#### Test suggestions\n- [x] Verify RoserpinaMoneyManagement rejects non-finite bankroll, exposure, and loss inputs\n- [x] Verify calculate_dutching_stakes returns error dict for non-finite odds\n- [x] Verify calculate_dutching_stakes returns empty stakes for non-finite total stake input\n- [x] Verify PnLEngine raises ValueError for non-finite entry prices, exit prices, or size\n- [ ] Verify PnLEngine raises ValueError for non-finite commission percentage inputs\n\n<details>\n<summary>Prompt proposal for missing tests</summary>\n\n```\nConsider implementing these tests if applicable:\n1.       "body": "<!-- Generated by sourcery-ai[bot]: start review_guide -->\n\n## Reviewer's Guide\n\nTightens numeric safety across money management, dutching, and PnL engine by rejecting/neutralizing non-finite values (NaN/inf) and adding tests to ensure guardrails while preserving valid behavior.\n\n### File-Level Changes\n\n| Change | Details | Files |\n| ------ | ------- | ----- |\n| Harden money management numeric conversion to fail closed on non-finite values. | <ul><li>Wraps safe_float in RoserpinaMoneyManagement._safe_float and returns the default when the converted value is not finite.</li><li>Ensures bankroll, exposure, and loss-related calculations cannot propagate NaN/inf and instead yield safe default floats.</li></ul> | `core/money_management.py` |\n| Introduce a finite float helper in PnLEngine and apply it to all user-facing numeric inputs. | <ul><li>Adds PnLEngine._finite_float, which coerces inputs to float (with a default) and raises ValueError on non-finite numerics.</li><li>Uses _finite_float for commission_pct resolution to ensure commission percentages are finite.</li><li>Uses _finite_float for entry/exit prices and size in calculate_position_pnl, rejecting NaN/inf at preview time.</li><li>Uses _finite_float for price and size in calculate_settlement_pnl, enforcing finite settlement inputs.</li><li>Uses _finite_float for entry_price, entry_size, and hedge_price in calculate_green_up_size to prevent non-finite green-up parameters.</li></ul> | `pnl_engine.py` |\n| Strengthen dutching Decimal parsing and guardrails for odds and inverse-sum calculations. | <ul><li>Extends _d to normalize textual numerics, explicitly treat various nan/inf spellings as invalid, and fall back to the default Decimal instead.</li><li>Adds finiteness checks on dutching odds, rejecting any non-finite or <= 1.0 odds before stake computation.</li><li>Adds a finiteness guard on the inverse-sum of odds, returning an empty result if the sum is non-finite or <= 0.</li></ul> | `dutching.py` |\n| Add unit tests to cover non-finite numeric guardrails and verify existing behavior remains intact. | <ul><li>Adds tests ensuring RoserpinaMoneyManagement rejects non-finite inputs and yields zero stake decisions.</li><li>Adds tests confirming dutching rejects non-finite odds/stakes while preserving valid allocation behavior.</li><li>Adds tests verifying PnLEngine raises on non-finite preview inputs and still produces correct PnL outputs for valid inputs.</li></ul> | `tests/unit/test_pr5_numeric_guardrails.py` |\n\n---\n\n<details>\n<summary>Tips and commands</summary>\n\n#### Interacting with Sourcery\n\n- **Trigger a new review:** Comment `@sourcery-ai review` on the pull request.\n- **Continue You can also comment\n  `@sourcery-ai title` on the pull request to (re-)generate the title at any time.\n- **Generate a pull request summary:** Write `@sourcery-ai summary` anywhere in\n  the pull request body to generate a PR summary at any time exactly where you\n  want it. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai summary` on the pull request to\n  (re-)generate the summary at any time.\n- **Generate reviewer's guide:** Comment `@sourcery-ai guide` on the pull\n  request to (re-)generate the reviewer's guide at any time.\n- **Resolve all Sourcery comments:** Comment `@sourcery-ai resolve` on the\n  pull request to resolve all Sourcery comments. Especially useful if you\n  want to start fresh with a new review - don't forget to comment\n  `@sourcery-ai review` to trigger a new review!\n\n#### Customizing Your Experience\n\nAccess your [dashboard](https://app.sourcery.ai) to:\n- Enable or disable review features such as the Sourcery-generated pull request\n  summary, the reviewer's guide, and others.\n- Change the review language.\n- Add, remove or edit custom review instructions.\n- Adjust other review settings.\n\n#### Getting Help\n\n- [Contact our support team](mailto:support@sourcery.ai) for questions or feedback.\n- Visit our [documentation](https://docs.sourcery.ai) for detailed guides and information.\n- Keep in touch with the Sourcery team by following us on [X/Twitter](https://x.com/SourceryAI), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sourcery-ai/) or [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcery-ai).\n\n</details>\n\n<!-- Generated by sourcery-ai[bot]: end review_guide -->"
